sentences.text:
The instant petition under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 (for short 'Cr.P.C)
has been filed by the Petitioners/Accused Nos.1 to 9, seeking quashment of the proceedings against them in FIR No.457 of 2024 of Proddatur I Town Police Station registered under Sections 420, 468,
506 r/w 149 of IPC.
2. I.A.No.2 of 2024 is filed by the Respondent No.2/complainant under Section 482 read with 320(6) Cr.P.C., seeking permission to compromise the case in in FIR No.457 of 2024 of Proddatur I Ponnampalli Chandrakala vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh on 10 January, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/120883928/
1 Town Police Station registered under Sections 420, 468, 506 r/w 149 of IPC.

3. I.A.No.3 of 2024 is filed by Respondent No.2/complainant under Section 482 read with 320(2)
Cr.P.C., seeking to record the compromise and quash the in FIR No.457 of 2024 of Proddatur I Town Police Station registered under Sections 420, 468, 506 r/w 149 of IPC.
4. Petitioners/A1 to A9 in individual capacity and Respondent No.2 appeared before this Court and were identified by their respective learned counsel.
Copies of their Aadhar cards attested by their respective counsel are filed for proper identification.
5. Sri C.P.Somayaji, learned Additional Public Prosecutor on behalf of the State is in attendance.
6. Learned counsel for Respondent No.2 would submit that both parties have compromised and settled their previous disputes between them.
Now the parties are intending to compromise the issue and filed a joint memo to that effect.
7. Considering the submissions, in the interest of justice, I.A.Nos.2 and 3 of 2024 are allowed.

Consequently, the Criminal Petition is allowed and the case against the Petitioners/Accused Nos.1 to 9 in FIR No.457 of 2024 of Proddatur I Town Police Station registered under Sections 420, 468, 506 r/w 149 of IPC, is hereby quashed.

As a sequel thereto, miscellaneous petitions pending, if any, shall stand closed.
__________________________________________ DR.
